const (
	HandleExpired    = -32000
	CapabilityDenied = -32001
	InvalidParams    = -32602
	MethodNotFound   = -32601
)

const FrameLimit = 16 << 20

const Version = "0.1.0"

func (*observerError) Error() string

func (c *Client) Call(ctx context.Context, method string, params any) (json.RawMessage, error)

func (c *Client) CleanupComplete() bool

func (c *Client) Close(ctx context.Context) error

func (c *Client) Handshake() Handshake

func (c *Client) Notify(ctx context.Context, method string, params any) error

func (c *Client) Shutdown(ctx context.Context) error

func (e *CallbackError) Error() string

func (e *observerError) Unwrap() error

func (f HandlerFunc) Handle(ctx context.Context, method string, params json.RawMessage) (json.RawMessage, error)

func (f ObserverFunc) Record(ctx context.Context, event IOEvent) error

func (p nativePeer) Errors() io.ReadCloser

func (p nativePeer) Input() io.WriteCloser

func (p nativePeer) Output() io.ReadCloser

func MessageFromDTO(m MessageDTO) (wire.Message, error)

func MessageToDTO(m wire.Message) (MessageDTO, error)

func Open(ctx context.Context, config Config, handler Handler, observer Observer) (*Client, error)

func ToolResultToDTO(result wire.ToolResult) (ToolResultDTO, error)

import (
	"bufio"
	"context"
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"
	"unicode/utf8"

	"github.com/QuincySx/Alva/platform/system/process"
	"github.com/QuincySx/Alva/sdk/llm/wire"
)

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"io"
	"time"

	"github.com/QuincySx/Alva/platform/system/process"
)

import (
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"

	"github.com/QuincySx/Alva/sdk/llm/wire"
)

type Action struct {
	Action            string          `json:"action"`
	Reason            string          `json:"reason,omitempty"`
	ModifiedArguments json.RawMessage `json:"modified_arguments,omitempty"`
	Result            json.RawMessage `json:"result,omitempty"`
	Messages          json.RawMessage `json:"messages,omitempty"`
	Response          json.RawMessage `json:"response,omitempty"`
}

type CallbackError struct{ Code int }

type Client struct {
}

type Config struct {
	Name, PluginVersion string
	Process             process.Config

	Start func(context.Context) (Peer, error)

	RequestedCapabilities          []string
	HostCapabilities               HostCapabilities
	ConnectTimeout, RequestTimeout time.Duration
}

type ContentDTO struct {
	Type          string                `json:"type"`
	Text          string                `json:"text,omitempty"`
	ID            string                `json:"id,omitempty"`
	Name          string                `json:"name,omitempty"`
	Input         json.RawMessage       `json:"input,omitempty"`
	Content       []ContentDTO          `json:"content,omitempty"`
	IsError       bool                  `json:"is_error,omitempty"`
	Data          json.RawMessage       `json:"data,omitempty"`
	MediaType     string                `json:"media_type,omitempty"`
	URL           string                `json:"url,omitempty"`
	Detail        string                `json:"detail,omitempty"`
	Width         int                   `json:"width,omitempty"`
	Height        int                   `json:"height,omitempty"`
	Provenance    *wire.MediaProvenance `json:"provenance,omitempty"`
	Signature     string                `json:"signature,omitempty"`
	RedactedData  string                `json:"redacted_data,omitempty"`
	Provider      string                `json:"provider,omitempty"`
	ToolCallID    string                `json:"tool_call_id,omitempty"`
	ProviderState []wire.ProviderState  `json:"provider_state,omitempty"`
	Reference     *wire.Reference       `json:"reference,omitempty"`
	Audio         *wire.Audio           `json:"audio,omitempty"`
	Video         *wire.Video           `json:"video,omitempty"`
}

type Handler interface {
	Handle(context.Context, string, json.RawMessage) (json.RawMessage, error)
}

type HandlerFunc func(context.Context, string, json.RawMessage) (json.RawMessage, error)

type Handshake struct {
	ProtocolVersion string     `json:"protocolVersion"`
	Plugin          PluginInfo `json:"plugin"`
	Tools           []Tool     `json:"tools"`
	Subscriptions   []string   `json:"eventSubscriptions"`
	Capabilities    []string   `json:"requestedCapabilities"`
}

type HostCapabilities struct {
	StateAccess []string `json:"stateAccess"`
	Events      []string `json:"events"`
	HostAPI     []string `json:"hostApi"`
}

type IOEvent struct {
	Direction string
	Frame     json.RawMessage
	At        time.Time
}

type MessageDTO struct {
	ID           string       `json:"id,omitempty"`
	Role         wire.Role    `json:"role"`
	Content      []ContentDTO `json:"content"`
	Usage        *wire.Usage  `json:"usage,omitempty"`
	ResponseID   string       `json:"response_id,omitempty"`
	FinishReason string       `json:"finish_reason,omitempty"`

	Timestamp *int64 `json:"timestamp,omitempty"`
}

type Observer interface {
	Record(context.Context, IOEvent) error
}

type ObserverFunc func(context.Context, IOEvent) error

type Peer interface {
	Input() io.WriteCloser
	Output() io.ReadCloser
	Errors() io.ReadCloser
	BeginClose()
	Close(context.Context) error
	Wait(context.Context) error
	ExitCode() (int, bool)
	CleanupComplete() bool
}

type PluginInfo struct {
	Name        string `json:"name"`
	Version     string `json:"version"`
	Description string `json:"description,omitempty"`
	Author      string `json:"author,omitempty"`
}

type Tool struct {
	Name        string          `json:"name"`
	Description string          `json:"description"`
	InputSchema json.RawMessage `json:"inputSchema"`
}

type ToolResultDTO struct {
	Content []ContentDTO `json:"content"`
	IsError bool         `json:"is_error"`
}
